title: Round 3 batch C of the slot contracts: JA Beauty, JA Blockk, JA Boxing and JA Campaign (Joomla j6, T4), measured not ready in round 1, wear a design system from their tokenized 1.0.1 releases
steps: S1: node --test test/contracts.test.mjs test/tokenize.test.mjs test/cms.test.mjs (cwd packages/design/tracy-ds-slot).
S3: apps/tracy-web/src/lib/ds-slot.js contractFor('joomla/<slug>', {key: 'quickstart/<slug>/j6', version}) at 1.0.0 and 1.0.1.
S4: tokenizeCss with JA Beauty's t4Placeholders and JA Boxing's varRoles on a one-rule sheet; joomlaSlot for JA Campaign under Moxie, JA Boxing and JA Blockk under Toggl Track.
expect: S1: every test passes, none skipped.
S2: all four ready, minVersion {'quickstart/<slug>/j6': '1.0.1'}, readyNote naming tasks/evidence/ds-contracts-r3c-2026-10-11/templates/<slug>-j6.

S4: '.section-title{color:__color_primary}' becomes var(--ds-c-accent-text, __color_primary); '--headings-color: #fff' becomes var(--ds-c-fg-2, #fff); JA Campaign's sheet has font-weight …!important and the mainnav rule '.t4-palette-mainnav .nav li a:not(.nav-link-signin)'; JA Boxing's sets --color-dark:var(--ds-c-surface) and hides .ja-dark-mode; JA Blockk's sets --color-desc:var(--ds-c-muted) and writes on body.dark-active.

selectors.contracts: packages/design/tracy-ds-slot/templates/joomla-{ja-beauty,ja-blockk,ja-boxing,ja-campaign}.json ready, minVersion, t4Placeholders, varRoles, templateVars, followRules, weightImportant, tokenScope

evidence: tasks/evidence/ds-contracts-r3c-2026-10-11/README.md — per-template table, screenshots, flow.json of the measure on each 1.0.1 build, VERIFICATION.json of each pack (11/10/2026).
fence: The measures on Docker stands (each 20–40 min on the shared VM) are in the evidence, not re-run here; the release builds are verified in their VERIFICATION.json; nothing is uploaded. Judging by eye is in the evidence.
